Neoclassical houses line the near quay, and Palamidi is a dark castle on the hill behind the town. Cloud cover is about 65%, about 17.5°C. No floodlight schedule was found for 03:15, so Bourtzi is in moonlight and the quay lamps, not a warm wash.
